engineeringFindings.title: P17's new same-break test (sameBreakNamed) compares names literally. When the earlier break carries its own episodeId, and the wrong-day answer and the valid answer name it in different forms, a correct runtime is false-blocked.
engineeringFindings.evidence: QH21 and QH22 are DEV-56 with the holiday reported with its own episodeId. The wrong-day answer names it by that episodeId and the valid answer by its report's event id (QH21), or the reverse (QH22). Both forms name the break: restatesListed and the runtime read either, as R07k showed in r1. The runtime's decisions are identical in QH21, QH22, QH23 and QH23b (both answers in one form): wrong is ASK, right is KEEP VALID, and then GATED_NEXT_STEP, ADOPT_LOGGED_LOADS and KEEP follow (out/trace.QH21-23b.33d3181.json). HARNESS-7 r2 fails QH21 and QH22 with P17 VALID_BEFORE_DECLARED_BREAK_APPLIED from 'right' on (declaredAt 'wrong'). QH23 and QH23b pass. This is a false block, the conservative direction, and it would fail a holdout on a correct runtime.
engineeringFindings.smallestFix: In sameBreakNamed, also resolve both names through the separate-break row that t names (its episode or its report's event id): the window ends when s names the same row. A scratch prototype is in out/qre3-p35-samebreak-prototype.scratch.diff; the instrument owner makes the change. On scratch: 33d3181 then fails nothing but the pre-existing VARIANT relations (QH21 and QH22 pass). QH-DROP is still detected on DEV-57, QH10, QH11 and QH12. 8e78b8a is still detected on DEV-53, QH17, QH18 and QH24 to QH28. The change needs an append-only PREREG addendum and a DEV case of the QH21/QH22 shape.
engineeringFindings.route: INSTRUMENT OWNER (Chief / harness author), before any final holdout exists

engineeringFindings.title: P18(e) requires actual.completed for a confounded report too. That makes it narrower than the runtime's reading and than Δ35's text.
engineeringFindings.evidence: This was found by inspection. kindOf reads any non-partial confounded report with recovery ADVERSE as ADVERSE, whether completed or not, and weekEvidence counts kind ADVERSE whatever the row status. Δ35 says 'relato concluído, não parcial, com desempenho diferente de OVER, ou relato confundido'. The code reads '!r.partial&&r.actual?.completed===true&&recovery ADVERSE&&(confounded||performance!==OVER)'. The subset stays a necessary condition, so no false block can follow. It misses a corner: a confounded report, not done or not complete, with recovery ADVERSE.
engineeringFindings.smallestFix: Use '!r.partial&&r.response?.recovery==='ADVERSE'&&(r.confounded===true||r.actual?.completed===true&&r.response?.performance!=='OVER')', or restate Δ35 to match the code, in the same addendum as QRE3-P35-02.
engineeringFindings.route: INSTRUMENT OWNER, before any final holdout exists
